goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: A maximum of 5 unused leave days may be carried over into the following calendar year. Carried-over days must be used by 31 March or they are forfeited. Carrying over more than 5 days requires written approval from the employee's direct manager and the Head of People & Culture.

story: An employee asks about the deadline and approval rules for carrying annual leave forward.
starting_sentence: Can unused annual leave be carried over, and when must it be used?
